relatedArticles.title: "Caraway appears to yelp before shapeshifting in a panic, swapping between several forms before rushing out of the room with the appearance of an amorphous mass of faces and tentacles."
"Oh! She's not dead, she's just American. I mean in America. Fuck can we just start this whole conversation over?"
Its path obstructed, SCP-7073 bites onto Dr. Carawy's tail. He yelps in pain as it reflexively swings back to his other side, pulling the still-attached SCP-7073 along with it.
"Art is something that makes people feel something, or gets them talking."
"Were you able to live your dream?"
"We want to make sure that all the information we have about your sister is correct. What can you tell me about her?"
"Udy-Lah" sounds very nice. Can I meet them?"
"No, no. Thank you for offering. I'm actually here to discuss another item we recovered from your vault. I know you've spoken with us about a few things already, but-"
"Success. So you do know how to talk to women. I was beginning to become concerned."
